title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.18037v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to answer from heterogeneous evidence sources, including search, APIs, databases, clinical records, and formulary tools. Standard factuality metrics usually test whether an answer is supported by pooled evidence, missing a provenance-sensitive failure mode: a claim may be supported somewhere while being attributed to the wrong source. We call this cross-source conflation.   We introduce ProvenanceGuard, a source-aware verifier for MCP-grounded answers. It consumes captured MCP traces with stable tool IDs, source IDs, and raw outputs; decomposes answers into atomic claims; routes claims to source-specific evidence; checks support with NLI and a token-alignment proxy; compares stated attribution with the routed source; and returns per-claim verdicts plus an answer-level allow/block decision. Blocked answers can be repaired with retrieval-augmented answer revision a

translated_title: ProvenanceGuard：基于MCP的LLM代理的源感知事实性验证
translated_abstract: 使用工具的LLM代理越来越多地通过模型上下文协议（MCP）从异构证据源（包括搜索、API、数据库、临床记录和处方工具）获取答案。标准的事实性指标通常测试答案是否由汇总证据支持，却忽略了一种源敏感的失败模式：一个主张可能在某个地方得到支持，却被归因于错误的来源。我们将此称为跨源混淆。我们引入了ProvenanceGuard，一种用于MCP接地答案的源感知验证器。它利用带有稳定工具ID、源ID和原始输出的捕获MCP轨迹；将答案分解为原子主张；将主张路由到特定源的证据；使用NLI和令牌对齐代理检查支持；比较陈述的归因与路由源；并返回每个主张的判定以及答案级别的允许/阻止决策。被阻止的答案可以通过检索增强的答案修订进行修复。
tldr: 我们提出ProvenanceGuard，一种源感知验证器，通过分解主张、路由到特定源证据并检查归因，解决LLM代理中跨源混淆的问题，并支持答案级允许/阻止决策及修复。
en_tdlr: We introduce ProvenanceGuard, a source-aware verifier that addresses cross-source conflation in LLM agents by decomposing claims, routing to source-specific evidence, and checking attribution, with answer-level allow/block decisions and repair.
